test_title: PYST 6: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: If Roshan lent Rs. 6,000 at 9% per annum compound interest, what will be the amount needs to pay after 2 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 6,000

Rate = 9% per annum

Time = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest Formula: A = P × (1 + R/100)T

**Calculation:**

⇒ A = 6,000 × (1 + 9/100)²

⇒ A = 6,000 × (1 + 0.09)²

⇒ A = 6,000 × (1.09)²

⇒ A = 6,000 × 1.1881

⇒ A = 7,128.60

**∴ The correct answer is 7,128.60.**
